scope: Current hybrid orchestration + offline LocalRulesModel; imported1107-category catalog, category_id=None, no feedback. Fixed heuristic gate compared with two independent agent reviews; not human calibration or external gateway quality.
reference: Two independently spawned blinded full-input agent reviews; not human gold

sample.selection: Fixed hash-ranked val sample absent from315 inventoried historical source files and old120-card benchmark; no gold/outcome filtering
sample.duplicates: Normalized word-trigram Jaccard>=0.8; exact prefix-filter search against train/historical cards and mutual selected cards; not semantic deduplication
sample.near_duplicate_scope: Lexical, not semantic; source identity checked against processed train and declared historical SKU IDs

review.nonaccepted_controls: One SHA256-ranked answer per card when available
review.unknown_and_disagreement: Kept unconfirmed in complete accepted denominators

decision.reason: All admissible heuristic scores equal1; raising the threshold up to1 retains the same errors. Fixed confirm results do not support target95% even against the agent reference. No sample expansion after results.

validation.review_packet_reproduction: Exact byte-identical subset from tracked packet builder

limitations: Agent consensus is not human gold
Historical inventory is bounded to declared artifacts; unknown external usage cannot be excluded
Exact binomial interval assumes independent card outcomes and does not account for annotation errors or lexical cluster dependence
LocalRulesModel validation does not measure external gateway inference
The fixed sample had only55 nonempty confirm cards; even55/55 confirmations would yield at most94.70% one-sided exact95 lower bound. Actual lower bound57.32%.
No accuracy guarantee for the shipped8-category demo configuration or real gateway provider
